title: How Much Does Voice Over and Podcast Production Cost?
h1: How much does voice over and podcast production cost?
description: Starting prices for voice-over artists and podcast production from the sellers we feature, and how script length, rights and editing change what you pay.
intro: Audio services look simple but have several price levers: script length, how the recording will be used, editing, and the rights you need. This article uses the starting prices of the voice-over and podcast sellers we feature to show typical ranges and to explain what drives the total.

faq.q: Is voice over priced per word?
faq.a: Often yes, or by script length bands. Larger packages cover more words, and usage rights can add to the cost.
Rules for where the recording can be used, such as web, broadcast ads or a product. Wider usage usually costs more.
Usually not. Most packages cover editing, mixing and sometimes show notes or publishing on audio you provide.

faq.q: Can I get a sample first?
faq.a: Many voice artists share demos. Ask for a short sample if the listing allows, and keep scripts short for the test.

faq.q: How can I reduce editing costs?
faq.a: Record clean audio in a quiet room, and send files organized and labeled with a short note about what you want.
